subject.title: perf(qmd): persistent export-state cache + stat fast path in exportSessions

question: Should this PR retain its original restart-safe QMD export-cache goal, or be narrowed to a process-local interval-sync optimization?
rationale: The force-pushed implementation deliberately removes persistence, while the title, motivation, and cold-start performance claim still require state that survives a new exporter instance; code review cannot choose that cache-lifetime contract safely.

options.title: Restore canonical persistence
options.body: Store the minimum revision and target identity in the existing scoped per-agent cache, preserving the restart benefit without adding another table.

options.title: Narrow to process-local
options.body: Keep the in-memory revision fast path, remove restart/persistent-cache claims, and prove only repeated syncs within one gateway process.

options.title: Pause the optimization
options.body: Close or pause the PR if neither persistent derived state nor an interval-only optimization is worth the additional transcript-corpus API surface.

recommendation.title: Restore canonical persistence
recommendation.body: Store the minimum revision and target identity in the existing scoped per-agent cache, preserving the restart benefit without adding another table.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the force-pushed design and the canonical per-agent cache infrastructure, making this the strongest available owner for the cache-lifetime decision.
